services.name: Hotbox Summer Camp Artist Market
services.desc: Come enjoy the fruits of our labor at our HOTBOX Summer Camp Artist Market. We’ve had a blast with this space this summer and invite you to join in on the fun. We will be hosting eight artists as they display their works for sale. Wares include: ceramics, tufted rugs, risographs, screenprints, sculpture, metal work, jewelry, embroidery, clothing and home decor. Inside, we will have a video art installation and various artist demos including throwing on the pottery wheel. Outside, our artists will be tabling their wares and jammin’ with the DJ. Please come out, have some complimentary drinks, and stay for a while as you enjoy all that these artists have to offer. Happy Summer! Mikayla

blurb: MASS exists as a volunteer-run, democratic collective built by artists, educators, and arts administrators dedicated to creating a site for creative and social action in collaboration with artists and organizations from and for the LGBTQIA+ community.
